searched.title: Hotends Combo - H2 Series (store page)
searched.note: Parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload, format legacy_html, route-derived productType "accessory"). The page has no specification table, no In the Box list and no weight or size: three description tables only. (1) "Comparison of Different Nozzle Sizes" (usage prose per size): not a spec. (2) A max-volumetric-speed matrix, nozzle × filament ("Bambu High Flow Nozzle (0.4mm) | 40 mm³/s | 48 mm³/s | 32 mm³/s"), one number per filament and including a 0.8 mm High Flow nozzle this combo does not contain: a matrix stays text (§C.6), so no motion.max_flow is stored; its "up to 62.5% … up to 30%" sentence is marketing and proves no number. (3) "Filament Compatibility" (39 filaments × 6 nozzles): its header gives each nozzle's material (nozzle.material) and its cells become relations. The Type values give the hotend count (contents.pieces) and, for the one single-diameter value, nozzle.diameter; the other 8 values mix diameters (0.6mm*2 + HF 0.4mm*2, 0.2mm*2 + HF 0.4mm*2, 0.8mm*2 + HF 0.6mm*2, 0.2mm*2 + 0.6mm*2, 0.6mm*2 + 0.8mm*2, 0.2mm*2 + 0.4mm*2, 0.2mm + 0.4mm, 0.4mm + 0.6mm), which the single-number key cannot hold, so their diameters stay in the value text. Filament relations: 11 filaments are √ for all six nozzles (product scope); per Type value a relation is written only when every nozzle in the value agrees (all √ or all X); 137 value × filament pairs with mixed cells or "Not recommended" get no relation. The safety sentence ("ensure that the hotend has cooled down before swapping") is not a spec key.

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The "H2 Series/P2S/X2D Nozzle" panel ("Max. Printing Temp: 350 ℃ | Size: 0.2mm/ 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm | Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel") describes the hotend type this combo bundles but does not name the combo; its sizes and materials agree with the store page. Its layer-height table is general guidance per nozzle size for every Bambu nozzle, not a spec of this product; not stored. Its High Flow sentence ("increases the maximum volume velocity by 62.5%") is marketing; not stored. It states no dimensions, weight or electrical value.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Linked from the store page ("Learn more about filament compatibility on Bambu Lab Wiki"). A general guide for every Bambu nozzle (columns 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 mm and 0.4/0.6/0.8 mm High flow), so none of its rows is stored as a spec of this product; it is used only to flag disagreements with this page's Filament Compatibility table on the relations written (PC at 0.2 mm; TPU 85A at 0.4 mm; PET-CF, PPA-CF and PPS-CF on the 0.4 mm High Flow nozzle). Its nozzle temperatures are per filament, not the hotend's maximum; its 0.4 mm hardened-steel advice ("Recommended layer height: 0.15–0.3 mm; maximum speed approx. 100 mm/s") is for fibre-filled filaments only; not stored.

specs.note: Conflict with the parsed store page: the deterministic row for this key holds "[Note] Learn more about filament compatibility on Bambu Lab Wiki." (unverified, official_page), which is a link sentence under the Filament Compatibility table, not a compatibility statement. This row (official_variant) outranks it at merge; mergeCurated records the disagreement (spec_sources_disagree). The wiki nozzles page gives a finer list for the H2 Series hotend type (see the relations), but it does not name this combo, so it is not used for this statement.

specs.locator: Types › H2 Series/P2S/X2D Nozzle › Max. Printing Temp
specs.quote: Purchase link: Bambu Hotend - H2/P2S Standard & High Flow | Compatibility: H2D (both left and right), H2S, H2C (left hotend), P2S, X2D | Max. Printing Temp: 350 ℃
specs.note: The wiki states 350 ℃ for the H2 Series/P2S/X2D hotend type (Standard and High Flow), which is what this combo bundles (store page: "Compatibility: H2 Series"; nozzles "0.2 mm Stainless Steel" … "0.6 mm High Flow Hardened Steel", matching the panel's "Size: 0.2mm/ 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm | Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel"). The wiki does not name this combo product, so the value stays unverified. The store page states no maximum temperature. In range (150–350 °C).
